column2: Once Deranged Assistant’s ability has been activated, it can’t be reversed for any reason.
column3: Outdated (conclusion B; ruling 2025-01-24, the same content in release notes since 2018-11-29): superseded by the CR 605.1a update effective 2026-08-07 (revision MagicCompRules 20260807: an ability whose cost or effect moves a card to or from a library is not a mana ability; Scryfall's Millikin ruling of 2026-08-05 on identical Oracle text, which now reads "(Activate only as an instant.)"): it uses the stack and can't be activated while casting a spell. Its stated outcome still holds when it is activated with priority before a cast that is then reversed (733.1). Tested in tests/rulings/r_p219_mill_resolution.rs (millikin_is_not_a_mana_ability, deranged_assistant_mana_survives_a_reversed_cast)
